classification: Independent Android native loader audit and corrected empty-manager replay; still not an APK-configured runtime

correction.affected_tool: Private experimental Android 15 selected-library loader v1
correction.problem: pyelftools 0.33 exposes ARM64 GNU indirect functions (ELF symbol type 10) as STT_LOOS. Checking only STT_GNU_IFUNC misbinds non-overridden imports to resolver entries as ordinary functions.

v1_actual_path_audit.limit: Read-only entry watches cover only the previously published empty-manager path; expansion required a corrected loader.

correction.fix: Version 2 recognizes STT_LOOS, STT_GNU_IFUNC and numeric type 10. Unresolved indirect-function imports stop, direct resolver entries stop unless explicitly handled, and unresolved IRELATIVE relocation data is guarded. Version 1 is frozen and not used for expanded APK work.
correction.older_game_bionic_reason: The separate older Bionic adapter already recognizes STT_LOOS and executes original resolvers with its recorded ABI inputs.

native_negative_cases.error: IFUNC resolver execution requires explicit resolver ABI: libc.so:strcmp

original_aosp_iterator_differential.scope: Exact original AOSP Android15-r1 packed relocation iterator and SLEB decoder compiled unchanged, with minimal ELF type/log header definitions; all actual packed sections compared tuple-for-tuple. Not a complete linker/startup proof.

remaining_limits: Only selected native slices are executed; global library initialization, original dynamic linker and full Android process startup are absent.
Memory primitives/allocation and gettid are modeled; TLS is synthetic.
An empty manager does not validate the game APK namespace, overlays, framework assets or original-device file state.
No Android/platform runtime equivalence, full match, complete state/reset or byte-identical battle proof follows from this audit.
